topic: AI Workflow Decision: Auto-Act or Ask First?

checks.ask_first_lane: Secrets, personal data or restricted data

checks.auto_act_lane: Rule matched and required evidence is available
checks.ask_first_lane: Evidence is missing, stale or conflicting

checks.auto_act_lane: Action is logged and included in an approved review process
checks.ask_first_lane: Human approval is required before action

checks.auto_act_lane: Tested stop or rollback path is ready
checks.ask_first_lane: No safe stop, rollback or accountable owner

decision_rule: AUTO-ACT only when every AUTO-ACT condition is true. Otherwise ASK FIRST.
override: Local policy and authorized human owners always override this educational gate.
boundary: Educational workflow-design material only — not a security assessment, legal or compliance advice, production authorization, performance guarantee, client case study or customer result.
